info.name: Clan realtime - member lines: join, leave and kick in the clan chat (TEAM-291)
info.description:
Member lines (TEAM-291): when a player joins, leaves or is kicked, Realtime stores a message with a `kind` (member_joined, member_left, member_kicked) in the clan's room and sends it to the members as message.new. The player is the sender and the body is empty (the widget writes the sentence). They are in the history, are returned with `kind` by GET /api/v1/conversations and the history, and never count as unread. A member_kicked line also has `kickedBy` ({ id, name }), the player who removed them, so the widget can write 'Bob was removed by Alice'; no other message has that field.

HOW TO RUN
1. Start everything: docker compose up -d (platform 8081, social 8082, realtime 8083, postgres, rabbitmq). Variables: baseUrl (platform), socialUrl, realtimeUrl, wsUrl.
2. Run folders 1 and 2 with the Runner (or request by request). They make a developer, a game with clans and clan chat on, four players (Alice, Bob, Carol, Dave) and Alice's clan.
3. STEP A (folder 3) is manual: it shows two WebSocket URLs (Alice and Bob). Open the tabs, then run folder 4.
4. Folder 4: Bob and Carol join. STEP B (folder 5) is manual: Bob sends two messages. Then run folders 6, 7, 8.
5. Folder 9 puts three events on RabbitMQ by hand (management API): set the collection variables rabbitUser and rabbitPassword (RABBITMQ_USER and RABBITMQ_PASSWORD of your .env). Skip it without them.
6. Folder 10 needs only folder 2.

Requests that wait for an event ask again by themselves (up to 8 times). Postman collections cannot hold WebSocket requests, so the two STEP requests only show the frames in the Visualize tab.

The members of a fresh game, in order: Alice (owner) creates the clan, Bob joins, Carol joins, Bob writes two texts, Carol leaves, Alice kicks Bob, Carol joins again, a redelivery check, Carol leaves again.

item.name: List conversations - Alice (200): her clan room, no member line for the owner

request.description: The owner's room starts empty: clan.created writes no member line, only clan.member_joined does. Retries by itself (up to 8 times) while the event is still on its way.

exec: // give the event a moment to travel: social -> rabbitmq -> realtime
const end = Date.now() + wait; while (Date.now() < end) {}
const room = j => (j.conversations || []).find(c => c.kind === 'clan' && c.clanId === v('clanId'));
// A member line: a message with that kind, the player as sender, and an empty body (the widget writes the sentence).
const isLine = (m, kind, who, name) => !!m && m.kind === kind && m.senderId === v(who + 'Id') && m.senderName === name && m.body === '';
const lineText = m => m ? m.kind + ' ' + m.senderName + (m.body ? ' "' + m.body + '"' : '') + (m.kickedBy ? ' by ' + m.kickedBy.name : '') : 'none';
// Only a member_kicked line has kickedBy, and then it is { id, name }: who removed the player. No other message has the field, not even as null.
const kickedBy = (m, who, name) => !!m && !!m.kickedBy && m.kickedBy.id === v(who + 'Id') && m.kickedBy.name === name && Object.keys(m.kickedBy).length === 2;
pm.test('Alice has the clan room', () => pm.expect(r).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('a clan conversation with Alice as its only member', () => { pm.expect(r.kind).to.eql('clan'); pm.expect(r.members.map(m => m.id)).to.eql([v('aliceId')]); });
pm.test('the owner starts without a member line: lastMessage null, unread 0', () => { pm.expect(r.lastMessage).to.be.null; pm.expect(r.unread).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 5 STEP B - Bob writes (manual)
STOP - STEP B: Bob writes two messages in the clan room (see the Visualize tab)

request.description: Manual step: Bob writes in the clan room over his WebSocket (one honest message and one that tries to pass itself off as a member line). Then run folder 6.

exec: const send = (id, extra) => JSON.stringify({ type: 'message.send', id, data: Object.assign({ conversationId: v('clanConvId') }, extra) });
const view = { wsBob: v('wsUrl') + '/api/v1/ws?token=' + v('bobToken'), m1: send('b-1', { body: 'gg wolves' }), m2: send('b-2', { body: 'not a line', kind: 'member_joined' }) };
STEP B - text messages and a spoofed member line (do this by hand, then run folder 6)

Use the Bob tab from STEP A, or open a new one:

{{wsBob}}

Send these two frames in Bob's tab (Message type: JSON), one by one

{{m1}}
{{m2}}
• Bob gets message.ack for each, then message.new for each (Alice's tab gets the two message.new too)
• both message.new have data.message.kind = "text": a player cannot send a member line. The extra kind in the second frame is ignored
• the bodies are exactly gg wolves and not a line

Carol has no tab: she gets the two messages from her history, and they are the only things unread for her.

`, view);
